candidate_set.name: model-only v2 composite (provided features + documented priors)
candidate_set.description: Single frozen model-only v2 composite: equal-weight mean of the model-defined transport route-reference, fixed building prior and POI components. No leaderboard-derived level, alpha, beta or probe region mean. Not uploaded: the frozen final-two protocol queues zero uploads and requires operator authorization.

parameters.composite: mean of defined components (equal weights, undefined excluded)
parameters.transport: ratio of provided Overture route and named-road lengths (no prior)
parameters.prediction_basis: model-side moments of the frozen artifact (mu_v, sd_v, E[v^2]) with the all-zero candidate C0 platform RMSE as the E[y^2] anchor, assumed target mean equal to the model's own mean and assumed centred correlation 0.3; no LB-derived model parameter

centred_correlation_breakevens.interpretation: the candidate beats a benchmark when its actual centred correlation with the target exceeds the listed value; below it the candidate is worse than that benchmark

candidate_set.hypothesis: The v0 detail failed because its component levels were uncentred proxies whose uncentred correlation with the target was 0.1786 and whose region-mean-removed detail was anti-informative (unconstrained beta -0.218). v2 replaces each proxy with a mechanism estimated from the provided Overture counts themselves - route/named-road ratio, fixed building residual prior calibrated against the Overture building presence rate, and the organiser's facility/establishments halves with fixed presence priors - so the composite should track the same completeness mechanism the organiser scored, giving centred correlation above the 0.30 forecast assumption and a public RMSE below the 0.091440198 P4 benchmark.

eastern_wa_fill.policy: uniform platform-only scalar 0.0 per b750a35; no eastern-WA features, regional-mean transfer, or target inference

upload_status.reason: docs/final-two-protocol.md queues zero uploads and requires operator authorization through the orchestrator gate; this row authorizes no queued upload

feature_source: provided Overture buildings/roads/POIs plus provided ACS housing geometries and strata covariates

platform_template.interpretation: Use the steward-confirmed 9,794-row Data-page template for platform processing. The authoritative four regional samples still define 9,379 scored IDs; the additional eastern-WA rows are template-only and filled with documented proxies, not target evidence.
